question: Does the held official source for this family bind, by SHA-256, to bytes present in this environment?
answer: NO. The build stopped at step 1. None of the five official sources this family names are present in this environment, so none of their pinned SHA-256 values could be verified against bytes.

gate.distinction: This is an ABSENCE, not a mismatch. No pinned hash was contradicted by bytes; there are no bytes to compare against. A mismatch would mean the corpus holds a different document. An absence means the corpus is not mounted here at all.
gate.consequence: Steps 2-3 and 5-7 (field census, measured field map, fixture render, byte-level artifact verification, rasterised visual review) all root in verified official bytes and were therefore NOT performed. Step 4 (local variation) does not depend on the form bytes and WAS performed - see local-variation-record.json.

whyTheDispatchPremiseWasWrong.dispatchStated: source-custody-reconciliation.json classifies this family SOURCE_ALREADY_HELD; acquire nothing, bind the held source.
whyTheDispatchPremiseWasWrong.butHeldMeansHeldByTheOperator: SOURCE_ALREADY_HELD is a statement about the operator-supplied Master Library Edition 1, not about this container. local-source-corpus-index.json records corpusRoot = private/source-imports/Expungement_AI_RCAP_Master_Library_Edition_1 and states plainly that private/ is git-ignored and the corpus itself is an uncommitted working input.
whyTheDispatchPremiseWasWrong.soNothingWasAcquired: Correct per instruction. No egress to court hosts was attempted. The gap is not an acquisition gap - it is that the already-held corpus is not mounted in this environment.

derivativesPresentButNotBindable.whatIsPresent: Three committed decrypted derivatives exist under data/rcap-all50/overlays/rescued-encrypted-pdfs/ for CR-180, CR-181 and CR-106. Their observed SHA-256 values match the values recorded in the prior lane's committed source records exactly, and their AcroForm widget-shadow field counts independently corroborate that lane's faithfulness proof (CR-180 81 fields against its recorded 81/81; CR-181 58 against 58/58).
derivativesPresentButNotBindable.whyThatIsStillNotAGatePass: A derivative cannot satisfy a gate stated over the official SHA-256, and not merely on a technicality. The derivative's tie to the official form rests on encrypted-pdf-rescue-report.json asserting sourceSha256Before == sourceSha256After == the pinned official hash. That assertion cannot be checked here, because the official bytes it refers to are the very bytes that are missing. Measuring write-box geometry off the derivative and publishing it as this family's field map would root a legal filing's coordinates in an unverifiable claim while presenting it as measured - which is the failure mode this gate exists to prevent.
derivativesPresentButNotBindable.whatWouldUnblockIt: Mount the Master Library at private/source-imports/Expungement_AI_RCAP_Master_Library_Edition_1, or commit the five official binaries. Either makes the pinned hashes checkable and steps 2-7 runnable as written.

twoSourcesHaveNoBytesInAnyForm.note: Unlike CR-180/181/106 these have no rescued derivative either. They are absent in every form in this environment, so no build path - not even a derivative-based one - could have covered them.

environmentReadiness.note: scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-pdf-rasterize.mjs renders through Playwright Chromium, which IS available here. Rasterisation was not the blocker; the absent source bytes were. poppler, MuPDF and Ghostscript are absent, as that script's own header anticipates.
